{{Top|leg}}
'''Turazza''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Turazza]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was composed of heeps, meeps and squeaks<ref name="D1">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref><ref name="WH">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> in what others perceived as a hodge-podge.<ref name="D1" /> Turazza language was not widely spoken through the galaxy.<ref name="WH" /> A number of Turazza, including [[Nizzal]], spoke both Turazza language and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="D1" />
